Wild singularities generate only in the §3Overworld and the Nether§r, at a tear-jerkingly sparse density — meeting one is pure legwork and luck.

The threshold is mercifully low: bare hands will do. But a dropped plain singularity §1detonates seconds after landing§r — it hurts entities, not blocks.

The critical kind is far worse: a shorter fuse, §cblocks and all§r, and it scatters more small singularities with fuses of their own.

§cDo not count your singularities on the floor.§r
